statement_text: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE sandbox.cust_engagement_metrics AS SELECT customer_id, concat('aabbxx', substr(phone_number,1,6), 'asfs', substr(phone_number,7,4)) AS engagement_key, segment, lifetime_value FROM gold.customer_master
rule_reasons: Substring / split / reverse style manipulation of a PII column
PII glued to padding characters or to other columns
Every target column was renamed away from its PII source name
PII moved without any one-way hashing or masking function
